description: harness.queue.changed (#1505 PR2); body text intentionally absent, same reason as harness.user_message.enqueued. `change` is one of edited|deleted|steered|dropped — this file shows `deleted`; `steered` has no emitter until PR3, `dropped` is emitted by the load-time queue truncation (#1505 PR2b), and all four spellings are pinned by calm_types::event::tests::harness_queue_change_wire_spellings. `actor` duplicates the envelope actor because the websocket frame does not carry it.
